title: 第3章 族运商城族运抽奖赌狗的破防第4章 赌狗的春天林天海
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 之后林轩不再纠结于此，而是开始继续研究起了系统……
毕竟，放眼当下，才是最重要的。
“系统，查看家族信息！”
“叮，已为宿主打开家族面板……”
【绑定家族：中州林家】
【家族品阶：圣族（下一品阶：准帝族！晋升条件……展开）】
【势力地位：南冥大陆一流势力】
南冥大陆所有势力按实力分为：不入流势力、三流势力（拥有尊者境修士）、二流势力（拥有圣人）、一流势力（拥有圣皇之上的强者）、超级势力（拥有大帝之上的强者）、霸主势力（拥有天帝强者）
【族长：林天海】
【族人数量：】
【家族气运：】
【族运点：（当前族运点产生：1000天）】
【系统评价：南冥大陆的豪强，诸天万界的弱鸡！】
看完林家的基本情况，林轩喃喃道：“唉，革命尚未成功，我林家还需努力啊……”
“目标，就先成为准帝族，以及南冥大陆的顶级一流势力吧……”
准帝族顾名思义，拥有准帝强者的家族，这等势力，乃是一流势力中最顶级的存在，即使是超级势力（也称帝级势力），平时都会给几分面子，不会轻易得罪。
虽然同为一流势力，但圣族和准帝族之间的差距却非常的巨大，毕竟不说那一般情况下，秒杀一切圣皇的准帝强者，光人家的圣皇、圣王等强者的数量，就远远非圣族可比的了。
随后林便查看起了家族晋升准帝族的条件……
【圣族→准帝族】
【晋升条件：1、拥有三名准帝境修士（未完成，当前人数：0）
2、拥有10名圣皇境修士（未完成，当前人数：3）
3、拥有50名圣王境修士（未完成，当前人数：15）
4、家族气运达到（未完成，当前家族气运：）】
看着这几个条件，林轩不由得摇了摇头，叹息道：“唉，任重而道远啊……”
不过……
“系统，一个家族，不是只需要拥有一位准帝强者，就是准帝族了吗？怎么到你这反而需要三位之多？而且还有这么多其它条件……”
林轩一脸狐疑。
这狗系统，不会又坑他吧？
面对林轩的狐疑，系统也很快给出了解释：
“叮，这乃是诸天万界公认的势力评定标准，绝不会出错。宿主若是不信，日后踏出南冥大陆，自可自己调查，确认真假！”
看到系统如此自信，林轩也只好作罢，不再怀疑。
content_en:
After that, Lin Xuan no longer struggled with this, but began to continue studying the system...
After all, looking at the present is the most important thing.
"System, check family information!"
"Ding, the family panel has been opened for the host..."
[Bound family: Zhongzhou Lin family]
[Family level: Saint clan (next level: quasi-imperial clan! Promotion conditions... expand)]
[Power status: First-class power in Nanming Continent]
All forces in Nanming Continent are divided according to their strength: unqualified forces, third-rate forces (possessing monks in the Venerable Realm), second-rate forces (possessing saints), first-class forces (possessing powerful people above the Holy Emperor), super forces (possessing powerful people above the Great Emperor), overlord forces (possessing powerful people above the Emperor of Heaven)
[Clan leader: Lin Tianhai]
[Number of clan members:]
【Family Luck:】
[Clan Luck Points: (Current clan luck points generated: 1000 days)]
[System evaluation: The mighty one in Nanming Continent, the weakling in all the worlds! 】
After reading the basic situation of the Lin family, Lin Xuan murmured: "Alas, the revolution has not yet succeeded, and our Lin family still needs to work hard..."
"The goal is to first become the quasi-imperial clan and the top first-class force in Nanming Continent..."
As the name suggests, the quasi-emperor clan is a family with strong quasi-emperors. This kind of force is the top existence among the first-class forces. Even super powers (also called emperor-level forces) will usually give some face and will not offend easily.
Although they are both first-class forces, the gap between the Saint Clan and the Quasi-Emperor Clan is very huge. After all, not to mention the quasi-Emperor strong men who can kill all Saint Emperors in an instant, the number of Saint Emperors, Saint Kings and other strong men alone is far beyond the comparison of the Saint Clan.
…
Lin then checked the conditions for his family to be promoted to the quasi-imperial clan...
[Saint Clan → Quasi-Emperor Clan]
[Promotion conditions: 1. Have three quasi-emperor realm monks (not completed, current number: 0)
2. Have 10 Holy Emperor monks (unfinished, current number: 3)
3. Have 50 Holy King Realm monks (unfinished, current number: 15)
4. Family luck reached (not completed, current family luck:)]
Looking at these conditions, Lin Xuan couldn't help but shook his head and sighed: "Oh, there is a long way to go..."
But...
"The system, a family, doesn't just need to have one strong quasi-emperor, or a quasi-emperor clan? How come you need three more? And there are so many other conditions..."
Lin Xuan looked suspicious.
This dog system won't trick him again, right?
Faced with Lin Xuan's suspicion, the system quickly gave an explanation:
"Ding, this is the standard for power evaluation recognized by all the worlds, and it will never be wrong. If the host doesn't believe it, he can investigate it himself to confirm the truth and falsehood when he sets foot on the Nanming Continent in the future!"
Seeing that the system was so confident, Lin Xuan had no choice but to give up and no longer doubt.
